(399)༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi khrid bdud dpung 'joms byed 'od zer rgyas pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (399)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi khrid bdud dpung 'joms byed 'od zer rgyas pa bzhugs so//

(400)༄༅// mi g.yo gzhan gyis bskyed pa'i yul las 'das// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa// 'gro ba'i 'khrul pa kun 'joms rdo rje 'dzin// bla ma gsang 'dzin dang bcas zhabs la 'dud// gang du bskyed rdzogs khrid kyi rim pa ni// rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i man ngag rnams// brjed pas 'jigs phyir yi ger bkod pa la// rdo rje gtum pos bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying po bsdus shing mthu stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi khrid bdud dpung 'joms byed 'od zer rgyas pa 'di la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro la yang gsum ste/ brgyud pa'i byung tshul dang*/ thum mong dang khyad par gyi sngon 'gro'o// dang po ni/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi tra dzo ki de nyid kyis/ dur khrod (401)chen po so sa gling du thugs dam lha lnga bsgrub pa ni 'od dpag med/ 'jam dbyangs/ thugs rje chen po/ phyag na rdo rje/ sgrol ma dang lnga'o// lha de dag bsgrubs pas/ so so'i zhal bstan nas ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bskur/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi gdams pa bstan nas rjes su gnang ba ni/ khrid 'di dag gcig brgyud du ston pa dang*/ mi rabs bdun gyi bar bdag cag rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gang zag sha stags 'byung ba yin gsungs so// dzam bha la dang brag lha mgon pos ni mthun rkyen bsgrub pa dang bka' srung yin gsungs so// rnal 'byor dbang phyug des phyag na rdo rje la dngos su gsan nas/ slar paṇḍi ta shrī pu tra la gnang*/ des rtogs ldan gīrti ratna la gnang*/ de bdag la'o// de dag rnams ni brgyud pa'i byung tshul rnams song ngo*// gnyis pa thun mong gi sngon 'gro la yang don rnam pa bzhi (402)ste/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/

'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa rnams ni gzhan dang mthun no// gsum pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la'ang bzhi ste/ dang po ci byas byang chub kyi lam du 'gro ba la skyabs 'gro sems skyed kyi khrid ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che du ma las grub pa'i khri mchog tu yangs shing rgya che ba/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyis khri dag pa can gyi steng du/ padma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi lte bar nya rgyas pa'i gdan la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs su bzhugs pa la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgya mtshos bskor ba/ mdun du yi dam phyag na rdo rje la yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas su sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis la sogs sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bskor ba/ rgyab tu yum chen mo la po ti glegs bam gyis bskor ba/ g.yon du byams pa mgon po la theg pa mchog dman gyi dge 'dun rgya mtshos bskor ba/ phyogs mtshams thams cad dpa' po mkha' 'gro sprin 'thibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa/ 'og chos skyong rgya mtsho rnams bzhugs pa/ de dag gi skyabs zhabs na bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad tshud par bsam la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam du sems bskyed nas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes sogs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyan ras gzigs kyi khrid dang mthun par (403)brjod do// mthar skyabs yul de dag 'od du zhu nas rang la thim nas/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med par chu la chu bzhag pa ltar ma bcos pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa sdig sgrib myur du dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi khrid ni/

rang gi spyo bor paṃ las sna tshogs padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa'i tshogs mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs khar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dku la brten pa/ zhal 'dzum pa spyan dkyus ring zhing dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud lnga phyed bcings shing*/ lhag ma'i zar bu rked par sleb pa/ rin po che lngas rtse phran dang snyan cha/ mgul rgyan dag do shal/ dpung rgyan dang phyag gdub dang 'og pags la sogs dar gyi cod pan gyis brgyan pa'i spyo bor oṃ dkar po// mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang lta bu'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ dam tshig pa la dbyer med du thim par bsam pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlabs nas sdig sgrib mtha' dag dag par (404)mdzad du gsol lo// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun them bu rdol ba lta bu zhabs kyi mthe bong las babs/ rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par deng nas rkang zhabs rtsa sgo chu sgo nas bud cing*/ sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu thim zhing*/ lus kyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis dkar mer gyis gang ba la shes pa gtad nas/ yi ge brgya pa 'don pa'i mthar/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum chu la chu bzhag gi tshul du/ lus ngag yid gsum ma bcos par bzhag go

/de ltar nad gnod sdig sgrib dag pa'i ltas ma byung gi bar du bsgom par bya'o// gsum pa maṇḍal kyi khrid la gnyis te/ sgrub pa'i maṇḍal dang mchod pa'i maṇḍal lo// dang po ni/ rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i maṇḍal gyi steng du/ me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod la/ lcags ri'i 'khor yug gi dbus su/ rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gling gzhi/ ri bo mchog rab kyi steng du rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bang rim tog gi mtshan pa'i dbus su/ pad zla'i steng du bla ma/ mdun du yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu dam chos/ g.yon du dge 'dun/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs rnams bzhugs par bsam pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan (405)drangs la dbyer med du thim par bsams pa ni bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal lo// gnyis pa mchod pa'i maṇḍal ni/ maṇḍal gnyis yod na logs su bshams/ gnyis med na sgrub pa'i maṇḍal mdun gyi nam mkhar btegs la/ slar mchod pa'i maṇḍal ni/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri 'khor yug /dbus su rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po zla gam las shel las grub pa ma rmos pa'i lo tog gis brgyan pa/ lho 'dzam bu gling sog kha baiḍūrya las grub pa nor bus brgyan pa/ nub ba lang spyod zlum po padma rā ga las grub pa 'dod 'jo'i bas brgyan pa/ byang sgra mi snyan gru bzhi gser las grub pa dpag bsam shing gis brgyan pa/ gling phran brgyad kyis bskor ba/ shar lho gnyis kyi nam mkhar me shel las grub pa'i nyi ma/ nub byang gnyis kyi bar na chu shel las grub pa'i zla ba/ byang shar du dus me/ lho nub tu sgra gcan/

ri rab kyi steng du 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ blon po rin po che// btsun mo rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ gser las grub pa'i nya/ rab tu mdzes pa'i padmo/ chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa'i bdud/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dpal be'u/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i 'khor lo ste/ (406)bkra shis rtags brgyad/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma ste phyi'i sgeg mo bzhi/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma ste/ nang gi sgeg mo bzhi/ mdor na lha dang mi'i longs spyod ma tshang ba med pa du mas kun tu gang zhing lus longs spyod dang bcas pa 'di dag bla ma dkon mchog mchod 'os rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces nyi shu rtsa gcig gam bdun nam bcu'i bar du maṇḍal phul la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de dag gis tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid song ngo*// bzhi pa byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid la bzhi ste/ dang po bla ma spyi bor bsgom pa ni/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu rin po che du ma las kun nas grub pa'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du sna tshogs padma 'bum ldan dang*/ zla ba nya rgyas pa'i steng du/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs/ de'i spyi bor rtogs ldan gīrti ratna/ de'i spyi bor shrī pu tra/ de'i spyi bor grub thob mi tra dzo ki/ sku mdog dkar po g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru sgra dang bcas pa g.yon dngul gyi dril bu snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dang bcas pa/ ras dkar po'i smad g.yogs can/

rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing*/ spyan nam mkhar gzigs pa/ de'i spyi gtsug tu phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad zla'i steng na skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas (407)rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams 'od zer gyis bsdus nas/ bla ma rnams kyi sku lus kyi stod smad rnams la thim pas/ bla ma kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid du gyur par bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ bstod pa dang*/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ maṇḍal kyang 'bul lo// gsum pa ni/ 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i mthar/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ bzhi pa ni/ bla ma'i spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying kha rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkar dmar mthing gsum las 'od zer byung nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la phog /sgrib pa gsum dag /sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob par bsam/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar dmar mthing gsum byung bas lus kyi nang gang bas/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob cing mthar yig 'bru gsum gdan dang bcas pa chad nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ dbang gsum brten par byas par bsgom/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma 'od du zhu nas gcig la gcig thim nas thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs (408)'bral med du phrugs kyis 'dres nas/ chu la bzhag pa ltar lus ngag yid gsum ma bcos pa'i ngang du rang babs su glod la mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor mthar thug go /de dag gis khyad par gyi sngon 'gro song nas/

gsum pa bskyed rim gyi khrid la gsum ste/ dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa dngos ni/ tshad med bzhi dang ldan pas a mṛ tas bgegs bskrad/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og gzhi sangs rgyas kyi zhing lcang lo can du gyur pa'i dbus su/ pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ sra brtan mi 'gyur ba/ phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i ra ba/ drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol tu mtshon cha bsnol ba'i tshad dang*/ me ri 'bar ba'i srung 'khor yangs par bsgom/ dbus su bhrūm̐ las gzhal yas kyi khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma bcu dang dbus su raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig gi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa'i tshogs mchod/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje nam mkha'i mdog ltar sngo ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ gsus khyim che zhing sku stod rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje (409)rtse dgu pa nam mkhar gdengs pa/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i dril bu thugs khar 'dzin pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum bskal pa'i me 'od 'phro ba/ sma ra smin ma 'khyug cing ral pa dkar ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ sku che la yan lag dang nying lag rags pa/ rgyal rigs dkar khras dbu la brgyan pa/ rje rigs ser khras snyan cha byas pa/ bram ze dmar khras mgul rgyan/ dmangs rigs ljang khras phyag gdub dang zhabs gdub/ gdol pa nag khras sku rags dang se ral khar brgyan pa/

'od 'phro ba'i rin chen sna lngas brgyan pa/ dar gyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ padma'i 'dab ma'i hūm̐ bcu yang khro bo bcu/ rang lta bu'i cha lugs kyis zhal nang du gzigs nas bzhugs pa/ lha tshogs de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ mthing kha/ de las 'od 'phros/ lcang lo can nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med du bstim/ slar 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dbang bskur bar gsol bas rigs lngas dbang bskur/ lus kyi nang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ rang gi snying gar pad nyi'i steng du rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ zhes pa baiḍūrya'i phreng ba lta bus (410)'khor bar bsgom pa ni/ zhi ba'i bsnyen po'o// drag po'i bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ badzra tsanḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i yig 'bru rnams 'od dmar po tsha zhing bsreg pa'i rnam par 'khor bar bsgom pa ni drag po'i bsnyen pa'o// slar yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros phyi snod la phog pas lcang lo can du byas/ nang bcud la phog pas phyag na rdo rjer byas nas/ thams cad zhal nas sngags kyi sgra sgrogs par bsgom la rtags rnams ma rdzogs kyi bar bsnyen pa'i khrid bya'o// mthar phyi snod nang bcud la thim/ nang bcud rang la thim/ rang thugs kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar dmigs pa med kyi ngang du bzhag go /des ni bskyed rim gyi khrid song*/ gnyis pa rigs lnga la brten nas/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i khrid la gnyis te/ dang po phyag na rdo rje rigs lnga'i 'od zer spro bsdu ni/ rang nyid sngar ltar phyag na rdo rje gsal bar bsgom pa'i spyi mgrin snying kha lte ba gsang gnas lngar/

padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu lnga las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ spyi bor rnam snang phyag na rdo rje dkar po/ mgrin par padma'i phyag na rdo rje dmar po/ snying gar rdo rje'i phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ lte bar rin 'byung phyag rdor ser po/ gsang gnas su las kyi phyag rdor ljang khu/ rnam snang lta bu'i cha lugs kyis me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dkar po/ dmar po/ sngon po/ ser po/ ljang khu lnga 'phros nas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi (411)khyab pas mchod par bsam pa ni rlung phar 'gro ba'i dmigs pa'o// rlung tshur 'dzin pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las/ mthu stobs nus pa ye shes dang mdzad pa byin rlabs gzi brjid thams cad phyag na rdo rje rigs lnga'i sku'i rnam par bsdus nas spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba/ gsang gnas lngar thim par bsam la/ rlung thebs re re bzung*/ yang rlung phar 'gro ba dang sbyar la 'od zer lnga 'phros/ rigs drug gi sems can lha dang lha ma yin dang*/ mi dang dud 'gro yi dwags dang dmyal ba rnams la phog pas de dag gi sgrib pa dug lnga sbyangs/ phyag na rdo rje rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam mo// rlung 'dzin pa'i tshe/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mthu stobs nus pa/ ye shes yon tan mdzad pa phrin las gzi brjid byin rlabs thams cad dang*/ phyag na rdo rje'i rigs lnga'i rnam pa/ 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu'i dbyibs su bsdus nas/ spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba/ gsang gnas kyi phyag rdor lnga la thim pas/ rang nyid sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi nus stobs ye shes mdzad pa gzi brjid byin rlabs mtha' yas pa dang ldan par bsam la/ rlung bum pa can gnas lngar bzung*/ mthar snod 'od du zhu nas sems can la thim/

sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la thim/ sangs rgyas sras bcas rang la thim/ rang snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar dmigs med kyi (412)ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de dag ni rdzogs rim mo// gnyis pa khyung rigs lnga'i 'od zer spro bsdu la gsum ste/ dang por spyi bor dbu rgyan gyi tshul du bsgom pa ni/ spyi bor sangs rgyas rigs kyi khyung dkar po/ dpral bar rdo rje rigs kyi khyung sngon po/ rna ltag g.yas par rin chen rigs kyi khyung ser po/ ltag par padma rigs kyi khyung dmar po/ rna ltag g.yon par las kyi rigs kyi khyung ljang khu rnams/ gnam lcags las grub pa'i mchu sder can/ rdo rje'i gshogs pa brkyangs pa/ rwa rnon po gnyis kyi bar nor bus brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dug sbrul bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i khyung rnams las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros nas rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ sems can rigs drug la phog pas dug lnga sbyangs nas khyung rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod nas/ slar de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mthu stobs nus pa/ ye shes gzi brjid byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu'i dbyibs sam/ khyung rigs lnga'i rnam par bsdus nas dbu rgyan gyi khyung rigs lnga la thim pas rang nyid sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mthu stobs nus pa ye shes gzi brjid byin rlabs mtha' dag thob par bsam la/ rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*// gnyis pa gnas lngar bkod pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje gtum por bsgom pa'i spyi bor sangs rgyas rigs kyi khyung dkar po/ mgrin par padma rigs kyi khyung dmar po/ snying gar rdo rje rigs kyi khyung sngon po/ lte bar rin chen rigs kyi khyung ser po/ gsang (413)gnas su las kyi rigs kyi ljang khu rnams ni gnam lcags las grub pa'i mchu sder can/

rdo rje'i gshog pa brkyangs pa/ rwa rnon po gnyis kyi bar nor bus brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis dug sbrul bzung nas gzhal du gsol ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i khyung rigs lnga'i 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu lnga'i bar 'phros nas*/ rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ sems can gyi dug lnga sbyangs nas rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mthu stobs nus pa ye shes dang mdzad pa gzi brjid byin rlabs thams cad khyung rigs lnga'i rnam pa can/ 'od zer lnga'i byin rlabs su bsdus nas gnas lnga'i khyung la thim pas/ rang nyid sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mthu stobs nus pa ye shes mdzad pa gzi brjid dang byin rlabs dpag med dang ldan par bsam la/ rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*// gsum pa yan lag lngar bkod nas klu 'dul ba ni/ spyi bor sangs rgyas rigs kyi khyung dkar po/ phyag g.yas par rdo rje rigs kyi khyung sngon po/ phyag g.yon par rin chen rigs kyi khyung ser po/ brla g.yas par padma'i khyung dkar po/ g.yon par las kyi khyung ljang gu rnams/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ gnam lcags kyi mchu sder can/ rdo rje'i gshog pa brkyangs pa/ rwa rnon po gnyis kyi bar na nor bu rin po che 'bar bas brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis dug sbrul bzung nas zhal du gsol ba/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i khyung rigs lnga la 'od zer dkar (414)dmar mthing ser ljang gu las 'phros pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod/ rigs drug la phog pas khyung rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod/ khyad par du klu rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs bram ze rigs gdol pa'i rigs lnga la phog pas/ de dag gi dug lnga sbyangs nas/ khyung rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mthu stobs nus pa ye shes mdzad pa thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu lnga'i rnam par bsdus nas khyung rigs lnga la so sor thim pas/

rang nyid sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mthu stobs nus pa ye shes mdzad pa gzi brjid byin rlabs kyi stobs rgyas par bsam la/ rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*// de ltar phyag na rdo rje rigs lnga dang khyung rigs lnga re dang*/ rlung bum pa can re re bzung ngo*// mthar ni snang ba thams cad sems can la thim/ de sangs rgyas la/ de rang la thim par bsam la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ de 'ja' yal ba ltar blo 'das yid la mi byed pa'i ngang du bzhag go /gsum pa bzlas la gsung gi khrid la gnyis te/ phyag na rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ khyung gi bzlas pa'o// dang por phyag rdor gyi bzlas pa la gsum ste/ dang po phyi'i bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje rigs lnga gsal ba'i snying khar/ pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po'i mtha' mar/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ zhes baiḍūrya sngon po'i phreng ba ltar dmigs nas/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ zhes bgrang*/ gnyis pa nang gi bzlas pa'i khrid ni/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying khar pad nyi'i steng du rdo rje sngon po me 'bar ba'i lte (415)bar hūm̐ yig gi mthar/ 'od dmar po tsha zhing bsreg pa'i rang bzhin gyi yi ge rang bzhin gyi yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'khor 'khor ba las/ ye shes kyi me 'bar bas lus kyi nang gang*/ nad don sdig sgrib thams cad bya sgro me la bsreg pa ltar bsam la/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bgrang ngo*// gsum pa gsang ba'i yid kyis bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje rab tu gsal ba'i snying gar pad nyi steng du hūm̐ yi ge zhi drag la sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang*/ ba spu'i rtse nas 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog /lcang lo can du byas/ sems can la phog /phyag na rdo rje rigs lnga'i skur gyur/ zhal nas sngags sgra di ri ri 'don par bsam/ 'od zer tshur 'dus lus la thim pas/

lus kyi sku dang ba spu'i tshogs thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i sku rigs lngar gyur nas/ zhal phyir gzigs nas me dpung gi dbus na sngags sgra sgrogs par bsgom/ slar yang 'od zer de lus kyi nang du zhugs pas/ lus kyi nang thams cad phyag na rdo rje rigs lnga'i skus tham 'gags su gang nas/ zhal nang du gzigs nas sngags sgra sgrogs par bsgom la bzlas pa bya'o// gnyis pa khyung gi bzlas pa'i khrid la gsum ste/ dang po phyi'i bzlas pa ni/ khyung rigs lnga'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du/ khrom dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu lnga la/ oṃ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐/ zhes lnga 'khor bar bsam la bsnyen pa bskyal ba phyi'i bzlas pa'i khrid do// gnyis pa nang gi bzlas pa'i khrid ni/ khyung rigs (416)lnga'i snying khar pad nyi'i steng du khroṃ dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu lnga las/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥg ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags 'di tsha zhing me 'bar ba'i rnam par 'khor bas/ lus kyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib bya sgro me la bsreg pa ltar bsreg cing*/ lus kyi nang ye shes kyi mes gang bar bsam la bsnyen pa bskyal lo// gsum pa gsang ba yid kyi bzlas pa ni/ khyung rigs lnga'i snying khar pad nyi'i steng du/ khroṃ dkar dmar mthing ser ljang khu lngas bskor ba las 'od zer lnga 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang*/ ba spu'i rtsa ba nas phyir 'phros/ snod kyi 'jig rten lcang lo can du byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la phog /thams cad khyung rigs lngar gyur/ rigs drug gi sems can la phog /thams cad khyung rigs lngar gyur nas/ sngags sgra drag tu di ri ri 'don par bsam/ 'od zer tshur 'dus lus kyi phyi rol gyi skra dang ba spu thams cad khyung rigs lnga/ sku chung la yan lag dod pa dpag tu med par gyur cing*/ tham 'gags su zhal phyir gzigs nas sngags 'dren par bsam/ slar 'od zer de lus kyi nang du 'dus/

lus kyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi khyung rigs lngas tham 'gags su gyur nas zhal nang du gzigs nas me dpung gi dbus na sngags sgra sgrogs shing bzhugs par bsgom mo// de ltar ma yengs par yid kyis bzlas pa bya'o// mthar snod bcud rang la thim/ rang snying kha'i sa bon la thim/ sa bon dmigs med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de ni bzlas pa gsung gi khrid do// (417)bzhi pa sems nyid thugs kyi khrid rdzogs pa'i rim pa la don bzhi ste/ dang po zhi gnas bskyed pa la don gsum ste/ thog mar mtshan ma la sems bzung ba'o// 'di la bzhi ste dang po ma dag pa ka ba bum pa la sems bzung ba ni/ ka ba bum pa shing bu rde'u gang yang rung ba zhig la lus gnad lta stangs dang bcas par sems bzung*/ de la yengs su yang mi 'jug /rtog pa yang mi 'gyed par/ de thog tu lhod de glod la rtog med du ma bcos par bzhag go /de la bying rgod byung na steng 'og dang g.yas g.yon du sems 'dzin pa yang shes par bya'o// gnyis pa dag pa rgyal ba'i sku la sems 'dzin pa ni/ mdun du phyag na rdo rje'i sku gzugs bzhag pa'am med kyang bsgom la/ de la rtog pa yang mi spro/ yengs su yang mi 'jug /de thog tu ma yengs tsam du glod la sems 'jog pa ni dag pa rgyal ba'i sku la sems bzung ba'o// gnyis pa nang ma dag pa'i thig le la sems bzung ba ni/ rang gi snying gar thig le sngo la 'tsher ba sran 'bru tsam zhig bsgom la/ de la yengs su yang mi 'jug /rtog pa yang mi 'gyed par sems bzung ngo*// bzhi pa ni/ rang gi snying khar pad nyi'i steng du phyag na rdo rje tshon gang ba me dpung dang bcas pa la sems yengs su yang mi 'jug rtog pa yang mi 'gyed par ma yengs tsam du sems bzung*/ dag ma dag gnyis ka'i skabs su byings na dpral bar sems bzung ngo*// gnyis pa rtog pa la sems bzung ba ni/ rnam par rtog pa thol gyis skyes pa ngos (418)bzung nas/

rtog med kyi mig gis cer cer bltas pas 'dzin med du zhig nas/ rang rig gsal stong yul med du gsal gsal 'char bar 'gyur te/ rnam rtog gang skyes pa'i ngo bo la gtad nas/ rig par rang ngo rang gis shes par byas la bskyang ngo*// de ni rtog pa la sems bzung ngo*// gsum pa mi rtog pa la sems bzung nas/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pa la mig nam mkhar gtad nas/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul thams cad rbad chod la btang la/ yid la ci yang mi bsam par stong gsal mtha' dbus med pa/ sems nyid ma bcos pa rtog med du gsal le hrig ger mnyam par bzhag go /de las rtog pa skyes na/ thol skyes rbad chod du btang*/ slar yang rtog med yid la byed pa mtha' dag dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /des bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams skye bar 'gyur ro// de dag gis zhi gnas song ngo*// gnyis pa lhag mthong la don gsum ste/ dang po rgyu'i lhag mthong gi sems la rnam par brtag cing dpyad pa ni/ bdag gi sems 'di gang nas byung zhing gang du gnas/ gang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ ces skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi ngo bo la brtag cing*/ 'byung ba lnga dang rang lus la 'byung gnas 'gro gsum 'dug gam snyam du brtag cing dpyad par bya'o// gzhan yang sems la kha dog dkar dmar sngo ser ljang khra la sogs pa'i kha dog yod pa zhig gam 'on te med pa zhig snyam du brtag cing dpyad/ gang du bdag gi sems ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dbyibs sam/ (419)zlum po/ gru bzhi/ gru gsum/ nar mo la sogs pa'i dbyibs su grub pa zhig yin nam snyam du brtag cing dpyad/ sems las rnam par rtog pa logs zhig yin nam/ 'on te rnam par rtog pa sems yin ces brtag cing dpyad/ gzhan yang phyi rol gyi snang ba las sems byung ngam/ sems las phyi rol gyi snang ba byung dpyad do// slar yang brtag mkhan gyi sems la yang sems kyis brtag cing dpyad/

sems de nyid yod pa zhig gam/ 'on te med pa zhig /gsal ba zhig gam 'on te mi gsal ba zhig /bde ba zhig gam 'on te sdug bsngal ba zhig /rtag pa zhig gam ngon te mi rtag pa zhig /snang ba zhig gam 'on te mi snang ba zhig /rig pa zhig gam 'on te ma rig pa zhig /bdag yod pa zhig gam 'on te bdag med pa zhig ces brtag cing dpyad du gzhug go /de'i tshe sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba ngo bo rang bzhin gyis stong pa nam mkha' lta bu la dbyings rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal zhing*/ rig pa 'gag med cing yang 'char zhing snang ba 'di thams cad/ skye ba med par ro mnyam gnas pa med pa dang 'gag pa med par ro mnyam zhes/ brtag cing dpyad pas gsal rig snang stong bzhi dbyer med pa blo 'das nam mkha' lta bu'i don mthong na/ de kho na nyid do zhes/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad sems nyid rtogs pa'i steng du tshang bar ngo sprad par bya'o// gnyis pa ngo bo'i lhag mthong tha mal gyi shes pa so ma cig car du nyams su blang bar bya ba ni/ sems nyid skye (420)'gag gnas gsum gyi mtha' dang bral ba/ bde gsal mi rtog pa nam mkha' lta bu/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa'i gzung 'dzin las grol zhing*/ ngo bo stong pa/ rang bzhin gsal ba/ rnam pa 'gag med kyi rig pa yul med du mar 'char zhir snang ba/ mthong bya mthong byed kyi 'dzin pa'i yul las 'das pa/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi dmigs pa'i mtshan 'dzin zhig pa'o// gang yang yid la mi byed pas yid byed dang bral ba/ de nyid la bzo bcos ma byas pas lhugs pa/ bya rtsol thams cad dang bral bas byar med gang shar ngos bzung dang bral bas 'dzin med/ mnyam bzhag gi shes pa bcos bslad dang bral bas had de ba/ mtshan ma med pas stong sang nge ba/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas gsal le ba/ rnam rtog gzung 'dzin gyis ma gos pas rjen ne ba/ rang ngo rang gis shes pas hrig ge ba/

rig pa ma bcos par rang lugs su 'jog pas tha mal gyi shes pa/ rnam rtog lu gu rgyud du snying mi 'jug pas rig pa so ma zhes bya ste/ yul yul can gyi 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ snang sems dbyer med thang thal le ba/ 'dzin med du phyal le ba/ rig pa rang ngo shes shing rang ngo mthong ba 'di nyid lhag mthong du nyams su blangs pa'i dngos gzhi yin no// zhes ngo sprad par bya'o// gsum pa mthar thug gi lhag mthong zhi lhag zung 'jug tu nyams su blang bar bya ba ni/ sems nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ bde gsal mi rtog pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la 'jog pa ni zhi gnas/ de'i rang bzhin mthong (421)zhing shes pa ni lhag mthong yin te/ de yang sems nyid mtha' gnyis dang bral ba ni gnas lugs kyi zhi lhag zung 'jug ste/ sems nyid skye ba med pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ de nyid 'gag pa med pas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral ba ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gnas pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ sna tshogs du mar rig cing gsal bas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ sems kyi ngo bo kha dog dbyibs su grub pa med pas rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ rtsal sna tshogs su shar bas chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ de rtag chad mtshan 'dzin las 'das pa'o// gsal rig stong gsum dbyer med zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs sgyu ma lta bu la sems gnas pa zhi gnas/ de dag rang bzhin med pa stong pa nyid du mthong ba lhag mthong*/ mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sems gnas pa zhi gnas yin la/ ngo bo stong pa nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i byams pa dang*/ snying rje'i dmigs pa la sems gnas pa zhi gnas yin la/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// lam gyi mthar thug bde ba chen po la sems gnas pa ni zhi gnas yin la/ de nyid zhen med stong pa nyid du mthong ba lhag mthong ngo*// snang ba thams cad sems kyi 'khrul snang rmi lam gyi grong khyer lta bu la sems gnas shing*/

de dag rten 'brel skye med du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i ngang du sems (422)gnas shing*/ ngo bo spros bral gsal stong skye med du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// bcos bslad dang bral ba'i rig pa so ma la sems gnas shing*/ bdag med rig stong yul med du mthong ba ni lhag mthong ngo*// mdor na chu zla dang me long gi gzugs brnyan dang brag ca ltar snang ba las gzhan pa'i stong pa med/ stong pa las gzhan pa'i snang ba med/ snang stong dbyer med nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba ltar rtogs nas de'i ngang du gnas shing*/ gnyis 'dzin mtha' dag sangs nas/ rang rig ye shes rgyas pa las sangs rgyas zhes kyang gsungs/ phyag na rdo rje zhes kyang bya/ phyag na zhes pa ni kun rdzob thabs kyi snying rje chen po/ gzugs sku zung du 'jug cing*/ rdo rje zhes pa ni/ ngo bo stong nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos kyi sku'i don no// de ltar sku gsum ye shes lnga la sogs pa lam dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i yon tan thams cad/ sems la rdzogs par ngo sprad par bya'o// gsum pa 'chi kha 'pho ba'i gdams pa la don gsum/ dang po sbyang ba/ gnyis pa las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ rang gi lus stong par sgom la/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba stong sang nge ba phra sbom smyug ma tsam pa mar sne gsang gnas la zug pa phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yar sne spyi gtsug la zug pa rgya mthong kha bye ba ltar gsal ha re yod pa/ spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkhar 'dom gang tsam gyi sar/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi dbus su pad nyi brtsegs pa'i gdan la bla ma dang tha mi dad (423)pa'i bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la khro bo bcu dang*/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba gsal bar bsgom la/ de nas rang gi sems kyi ngo bo gsang gnas su thig le sngo dmar gnyis gcig thog na gcig brtsegs te gnas pa la/

mar me gcig las gcig chad pa ltar sngon po lam mkhan gyi tshul du dbu ma'i nang nas thon/ snying khar hūm̐ bsam la bskor ba re byas nas spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas rgyangs se bud nas/ phyag na rdo rje thugs khar reg pa re byas/ slar yang snying kha'i hūm̐ la bskor ba re byas nas gzhi'i thig le dmar po la 'khor bar bsgom/ de'i dus su gyen la 'phen pa'i tshe hika ces 'phen cing*/ zur du phab pa'i tshe ka zhes brjod cing*/ gzhi'i thig le la thim par bsgom/ de ltar tshar nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du sbyang ngo*// mthar bla ma rang la thim/ tshangs bugs rdo rje rgya gram gyis bkag par bsam pa ni sbyang ba'o// gnyis pa las la sbyor ba ni/ 'chi rtags tshang ba'i tshe/ 'jig rten gyi zhen chags thams cad spang la/ sngar ltar rtsa dbu ma gsal btab/ snying khar hūm̐ yig dang*/ gsang gnas su thig le sngo dmar gsal gdab ste/ thog mar thig le sngon po chad nas hūm̐ yig la thim pas hūm̐ yig skar mda' ltung ba ltar phyag na rdo rje'i thugs khar thim par bsam la/ dmigs pa dang rlung sems drag tu gtad/ de'i tshe 'pho ma nus kyi bar du dmigs pa yang yang bskyar ro// mthar phyag na rdo rje dang rang sems dbyer med du lcang lo can du rdzu 'phrul gyis phyin nas/ nges par lcang lo can du 'pho bar 'gyur ro// (424)bzhi pa bar do'i khrid la don gsum ste/ dang po sbyang ba ni/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi sgo nas sbyong ba ste/ dang po 'dun pa ni/ bdag ni shi ba yin/ 'di bar do yin/ bar do'i snang ba yin/ lus la bden pa med snyam du nges par byas la/ snang ba thams cad lcang lo can gyi pho brang du bsgom/ sems can thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal ba brtan pas/ sems can thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgom/ rigs lnga la brten nas bskyed rim 'od zer spro bsdu'i khrid sngar ltar bsgom/ mthar de dag sgyu ma rmi lam chu zla ltar gsal stong skye med blo 'das yid la mi byed pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa ni rdzogs rim gyi sgo nas sbyangs ba'o// gnyis pa ni/

'chi ba'i tshe sa chu la thim pa'i rtags su lus po lci/ chu me la thim pa'i rtags su kha sna skam/ me rlung la thim pa'i rtags su drod rnams mtha' nas sdud/ rlung nam mkha' la thim pa'i rtags su phyi dbugs chad/ nam mkha' rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i rtags su dar gcig brgyal/ de'i dus su rim bzhin du nang rtags su du ba/ smig rgyu/ me khyer dang*/ mar me dang*/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la sogs pa 'char bar 'gyur ro// de nas pha las thob pa'i thig le thur du lhung bas dkar lam 'byung*/ ma las thob pa'i rakta gyen du 'dril bas dmar lam 'byung*/ snying khar rtsa ba santa'i nang du sems dang rlung byang sems dkar dmar bzhi sbrag tu gnas pa dang por nag lam byung zhing*/ de nas bde gsal mi rtog pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin 'char bar 'gyur ro// de'i ngang du gnas na bar do dang po chos (425)sku'i zhing du sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// gsum pa srid pa bar dor 'pho na snang ba thams cad lcang lo can gyi zhing du bsgom/ bdag dang sems can thams cad phyag na rdo rjer bsgom/ gnas lnga rig lnga bkod la 'od zer spro bsdu bya/ sgra thams cad sngags sgrar bsgom/ dran rtog thams cad chos sku skye med du rang ngo shes par bya'o// phyag na rdo rje'i zhing khams lcang lo can du 'dun pa yang yang gtad/ des ni bar dor phyag na rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub nas phyag na rdo rje'i zhing khams lcang lo can du skye bar 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum po'i bskyed rdzogs khrid kyi rim pa rdzogs so/// /dus mtha'i me lce'i phreng ba cher 'phros pas// srid gsum sems can sgrib tshogs kun bsreg ste// sku gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob nas// phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang mchog thob shog /ces grub chen mi tra dzo ki nas brgyud pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i thugs khrid bdud dpung 'joms byed 'od zer kun tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i khrid kyi rim pa ngag tu brgyud pa las/

brjed pas mi 'phrog pa'i phyir rnal 'byor pa 'od dpag rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po des/ 'gro kun bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mchog 'grub par gyur cig /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /sarba dā shubhaṃ/
